field_meaning.hi: rectified linear unit गैर-रैखिकता जोड़ता है।

review_objections: NVIDIA: Circular definition: Hindi meaning includes the English term 'rectified linear unit'.

Alibaba: The Hindi description is incomplete/incorrect. An ReLU is an activation function, not just something that 'adds non-linearity' (many things do that). It specifically outputs the input if positive, zero otherwise.
